text: ProgressEventFunctionUsingNameWithString forwards the protocol mailbox identity to the folder sink. ProgressStatusString resolves that identity with FindOnlineSubFolder, asks the matched folder for GetLocalizedName and formats the user-visible status. The IDL, implementation and synchronous wrapper change together from a UTF-16 display argument to a UTF-8 mailbox name. A missing local match leaves the substituted name empty; there is no raw-mailbox fallback in this path. The protocol's actual wire mailbox names remain separate.
title: IMAP mailbox status names are localized at the folder sink
